---
name: layout-rotated-text-box-dimension-mismatch
description: Prevention strategy for rotated-text-box-dimension-mismatch.
---

For quarter-turn text, size the unrotated text box to fit the horizontal string, then rotate around the intended visual center.

For quarter-turn text, size the unrotated box to fit the complete horizontal string, then rotate it around the intended visual center.

Candidate only; promote after controlled probe validation.
